rules.sequence-scope: Sections 7.6.1 and 8.4.13; Sequence Flow cannot cross a process or subprocess boundary.
rules.sequence-endpoint-type: Table 8.51 and FlowNode text, printed pages 97-98; sourceRef and targetRef have type FlowNode with process/choreography restrictions.
rules.flow-node-association: Table 8.52, printed page 98; incoming/outgoing identify Sequence Flows connected to the FlowNode. Optional serialized lists are checked when provided.
rules.default-flow: Table 10.3 and Gateway attribute tables; default identifies an outgoing SequenceFlow of its owner. A condition on a default flow is ignored, not rejected by this family.
rules.event-direction: Sections 10.5.2 and 10.5.3; Start/End Events have no incoming/outgoing Sequence Flows respectively.
rules.boundary-attachment: Section 10.5.4 and BoundaryEvent model association; attachment is a process Activity in the same scope. Table 11.7 also permits boundary Events on Choreography Activities; complete trigger and participant-band depiction restrictions remain unverified.
rules.boundary-flow: Section 10.5.4; attached Intermediate Events have no incoming Sequence Flow.
rules.event-subprocess-flow: Section 10.3.5 Event Sub-Processes; triggeredByEvent subprocesses do not participate in normal Sequence Flow.
rules.parallel-conditions: Section 10.6.4 Parallel Gateway; outgoing Sequence Flows have no conditionExpression.
rules.event-gateway-target: Section 10.6.6, printed pages 296-297; process targets are intermediate catching events or Receive Tasks. Section 11.7.2, page 349 permits Choreography Activities and Timer/Signal Intermediate Events.
rules.event-gateway-conditions: Section 10.6.6, printed pages 296-297; outgoing Sequence Flows have no conditionExpression; the EventBasedGateway metamodel/XSD has no default attribute.
rules.event-gateway-cardinality: Section 10.6.6, printed page 296; at least two outgoing Sequence Flows.
rules.event-gateway-configuration: Section 10.6.6, printed page 297; allowed Message/Signal/Timer/Conditional/Multiple triggers, Message-catch/ReceiveTask exclusion, no attached events on ReceiveTasks and no additional incoming flow to targets.
rules.event-gateway-instantiation: Section 10.6.6 and Table 10.127, printed pages 298-299; Parallel requires instantiate=true; instantiating process gateways have no incoming Sequence Flow. Section 13.4.4, page 437 limits Parallel start gateways to message-based triggers; correlation information remains unverified. Choreography instantiation remains a separate unverified obligation.
rules.compensation-flow: Sections 10.5.4/10.7 and Activity isForCompensation; compensation activities are outside normal Sequence Flow.
rules.cancel-scope: Cancel event description in sections 10.5.3/10.5.4/10.5.5; process Cancel ends a Transaction or is attached to one. Table 10.90, page 254 requires interruption; Table 11.7, page 342 permits interrupting Cancel catch on Choreography Activities. Referenced root definitions are evaluated in the using event's context. Participant-band depiction and complete choreography lifecycle remain unverified.
rules.throw-trigger: Section 10.5.1; Timer and Conditional are implicit triggers caught by Events, not explicitly thrown.
rules.message-pool: Section 7.6.2 and Message Flow section 9.4; Message Flow cannot connect elements of the same Pool.
rules.message-endpoint-type: Table 9.8 and section 9.4.1, printed page 122; sourceRef/targetRef are Participants, Activities or Events, excluding Gateways and Data Objects.
rules.choreography-participants: ChoreographyActivity initiatingParticipantRef association; initiator is one of its participantRefs. Message-flow participation/cardinality is a remaining separate obligation.
rules.di-shape: Section 12.2.3.3 and Annex B Bounds; semantic reference and finite coordinates with positive dimensions. Coordinate positivity and complete notation constraints remain outside this family.
rules.di-edge: Section 12.2.3.5 and Annex B Edge/Point; semantic connector, at least two waypoints, coordinates of type Real. Complete data-association exceptions and notation remain unverified.

reference_resolution: Section 15.3.2, printed pages 476-477; QName local part identifies the ID. Only same-targetNamespace prefixes resolve locally; external/undeclared/shadowed prefixes remain blocked. SequenceFlow sourceRef/targetRef remain IDREFs under the official XSD.
